sources.title: ONNX Model Zoo
sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models. Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. sources.title: Centaur31/gpt2-fp16-onnx · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model uses internally a mask-mechanism to make sure the predictions for the token i only uses the inputs from 1 to i but not the future tokens. This way, the model learns an inner representation of the English language that can then be used to extract features useful for downstream tasks.
